integrity_notice: NigerFlora provides computational analysis, reproducibility records, visualization and research support. Outputs are hypothesis-generating research evidence and do not replace experimental validation, clinical evidence, supervisor review, ethics approval, regulatory review or the researcher's authorship responsibility.
